text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS games_played FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE LOWER(player_name) = LOWER('Totally Imaginary Person') AND played = 1 AND game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY player_id, player_name
